s0501.literal: Branch secretariat transport commission officials were summoned to the capital to assemble and deliberate on methods for governing levies.
s0501.idiomatic: Branch secretariat transport commission officials were summoned to the capital to assemble and deliberate on methods for governing levies.

s0502.literal: On xinmao day famine struck the dependent households of Prince Chubo; rice was issued for relief.
s0502.idiomatic: On xinmao day famine struck the dependent households of Prince Chubo; rice was issued for relief.

s0503.literal: On guisi day Wuping Route suffered famine; this year's field rent was remitted.
s0503.idiomatic: On guisi day Wuping Route suffered famine; this year's field rent was remitted.

s0504.literal: Wuping Route director-general Zhang Lidao was appointed minister of rites and sent as envoy to Jiaozhi.
s0504.idiomatic: Wuping Route director-general Zhang Lidao was appointed minister of rites and sent as envoy to Jiaozhi.

s0505.literal: Corvée for Weihui households planting curculigo was remitted.
s0505.idiomatic: Corvée for Weihui households planting curculigo was remitted.

s0506.literal: At Liaoyang branch secretariat's request, because Nayan and Hede had rebelled in succession, an edict granted cattle, livestock, and farm implements to thirty thousand attached Mongols and persons of Kaiyuan, Nanjing, and Shuidada.
s0506.idiomatic: At Liaoyang branch secretariat's request, because Nayan and Hede had rebelled in succession, an edict granted cattle, livestock, and farm implements to 30,000 attached Mongols and persons of Kaiyuan, Nanjing, and Shuidada.

s0507.literal: An edict strictly enforced hunting prohibitions in Yidu, Panyang, Tai'an, Ninghai, Dongping, and Jining; violators had half their household property confiscated.
s0507.idiomatic: An edict strictly enforced hunting prohibitions in Yidu, Panyang, Tai'an, Ninghai, Dongping, and Jining; violators had half their household property confiscated.

s0508.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day, vacant land in Gansu was granted to Hesan and other Sibaochi to farm.
s0508.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on bingshen day, vacant land in Gansu was granted to Hesan and other Sibaochi to farm.

s0509.literal: On renyin day Zuoji was dispatched as envoy to Xinhela de yin.
s0509.idiomatic: On renyin day Zuoji was dispatched as envoy to Xinhela de yin.

s0510.literal: On jiachen day Venus transgressed Fang.
s0510.idiomatic: On jiachen day Venus transgressed Fang.

s0511.literal: The Grand Storehouse Directorate's supernumerary staff was reduced by thirty-one persons; the Equipment and Traveling Inner Treasury depots were abolished.
s0511.idiomatic: The Grand Storehouse Directorate's supernumerary staff was reduced by 31 persons; the Equipment and Traveling Inner Treasury depots were abolished.

s0512.literal: An edict: "Muslims who present danafa pearls as tribute or seek to sell them shall have them returned; the appraised value shall be kept to aid the poor.
s0512.idiomatic: An edict ordered, "Muslims who present danafa pearls as tribute or seek to sell them shall have them returned; the appraised value shall be kept to aid the poor.

s0513.literal: " Tachar and Tadai suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
s0513.idiomatic: Tachar and Tadai suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.

s0514.literal: Four months' grain was granted to Anda'er commoner households; the Sea Route Grain Transport Pacification Office was abolished.
s0514.idiomatic: Four months' grain was granted to Anda'er commoner households; the Sea Route Grain Transport Pacification Office was abolished.

s0515.literal: On bingwu day Mars transgressed Kang.
s0515.idiomatic: On bingwu day Mars transgressed Kang.

s0516.literal: On dingwei day the moon transgressed Bi.
s0516.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon transgressed Bi.

s0517.literal: Tamna dispatched envoys presenting one hundred bolts of eastern ramie as tribute.
s0517.idiomatic: Tamna dispatched envoys presenting 100 bolts of eastern ramie as tribute.

s0518.literal: Sacrificial rites were performed atop the Astronomical Observatory's Spirit Platform for three days and nights.
s0518.idiomatic: Sacrificial rites were performed atop the Astronomical Observatory's Spirit Platform for three days and nights.

s0519.literal: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Jupiter.
s0519.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Jupiter.

s0520.literal: Chenzhou Route darughachi Qulie was judged guilty and sentenced to execution.
s0520.idiomatic: Chenzhou Route darughachi Qulie was judged guilty and sentenced to execution.

s0521.literal: The Interpreters Hostel was reestablished; obstruction and harassment of gold panning in Yidu were forbidden.
s0521.idiomatic: The Interpreters Hostel was reestablished; obstruction and harassment of gold panning in Yidu were forbidden.

s0522.literal: On yimao day Xintian Ge Man pacification commissioner Song led cave officials Afen and Qinggui to present local products as tribute.
s0522.idiomatic: On yimao day Xintian Ge Man pacification commissioner Song led cave officials Afen and Qinggui to present local products as tribute.

s0523.literal: Surveillance censors said: "Shabuding, Nasir al-Din Amir, Ulai'er, Wang Juji, Lianzhenjia, Shadi, and Jiaohuade were all Sangge's partisans; accepting bribes and acting tyrannically, they made the people of Jiang and Huai full of grief and resentment; now some are imprisoned and some released — this your subjects cannot comprehend.
s0523.idiomatic: Surveillance censors said, "Shabuding, Nasir al-Din Amir, Ulai'er, Wang Juji, Lianzhenjia, Shadi, and Jiaohuade were all Sangge's partisans; accepting bribes and acting tyrannically, they made the people of Jiang and Huai full of grief and resentment; now some are imprisoned and some released — this your subjects cannot comprehend.

s0524.literal: " The Emperor said: "Sangge has already been executed; Nasir al-Din Amir is in prison; only Shabuding do I for now release."
s0524.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Sangge has already been executed; Nasir al-Din Amir is in prison; only Shabuding do I for now release."

s0525.literal: " Wuping, Pingluan, and other prefectures suffered famine; hunting prohibitions were relaxed; when beasts were pregnant they were not to be hunted.
s0525.idiomatic: Wuping, Pingluan, and other prefectures suffered famine; hunting prohibitions were relaxed; when beasts were pregnant they were not to be hunted.

s0526.literal: The Central Secretariat was instructed to deliberate on increasing salaries of inner and outer officials.
s0526.idiomatic: The central secretariat was instructed to deliberate on increasing salaries of inner and outer officials.

s0527.literal: On wuwu day Jinchi dispatched Asai to audience at court.
s0527.idiomatic: On wuwu day Jinchi dispatched Asai to audience at court.

s0528.literal: On gengshen day Mars transgressed Di.
s0528.idiomatic: On gengshen day Mars transgressed Di.

s0529.literal: On xinyou day Xuande's Longmen town was promoted to Wangyun County, severed and placed under Yun Prefecture; the Wangyun silver smeltery was established.
s0529.idiomatic: On xinyou day Xuande's Longmen town was promoted to Wangyun County, severed and placed under Yun Prefecture; the Wangyun silver smeltery was established.

s0530.literal: Twelfth month, on yichou day, the Directorate of Waterways was restored at rank 3b.
s0530.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on yichou day, the directorate of waterways was restored at rank 3b.

s0531.literal: Officials were dispatched to meet envoys sent from Yunnan's Yachi.
s0531.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to meet envoys sent from Yunnan's Yachi.

s0532.literal: The Jurchen tribespeople of Liaoyang's Hongkuan suffered famine; Goryeo grain was borrowed to relieve them.
s0532.idiomatic: The Jurchen tribespeople of Liaoyang's Hongkuan suffered famine; Goryeo grain was borrowed to relieve them.

s0533.literal: Adult males from sixty thousand tammaq households under Bahudai'er and others were registered as soldiers.
s0533.idiomatic: Adult males from 60,000 tammaq households under Bahudai'er and others were registered as soldiers.

s0534.literal: On dingmao day, among Goryeo's nineteen relay stations west of the Yalu River, because of Nayan's rebellion their horses and livestock had been plundered; forty head of cattle each were granted.
s0534.idiomatic: On dingmao day, among Goryeo's 19 relay stations west of the Yalu River, because of Nayan's rebellion their horses and livestock had been plundered, 40 head of cattle each were granted.

s0535.literal: Dadu suffered famine; two hundred thousand shi of rice was sold at reduced price for relief.
s0535.idiomatic: Dadu suffered famine; 200,000 shi of rice was sold at reduced price for relief.

s0536.literal: On jisi day an edict abolished officials dispatched to gather Uyghurs.
s0536.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict abolished officials dispatched to gather Uyghurs.

s0537.literal: The Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures transport commission was changed to the Hubei-Hunan Circuit transport commission; the Ge Man military-civilian pacification commission was established.
s0537.idiomatic: The Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures transport commission was changed to the Hubei-Hunan Circuit transport commission; the Ge Man military-civilian pacification commission was established.

s0538.literal: Xuanzheng Court officials said: "Former Song Empress Dowager Quan and the Lord of Ying, mother and son, having become monk and nun, hold land of three hundred sixty qing; we request exemption from rent as in precedent.
s0538.idiomatic: Xuanzheng Court officials said, "Former Song Empress Dowager Quan and the Lord of Ying, mother and son, having become monk and nun, hold land of 360 qing; we request exemption from rent as in precedent.

s0540.literal: On xinwei day Tiemie was made minister of war with tiger tally; Mingsi Xedashi was made vice minister of war with gold tally, and they were sent as envoys to Luobo'er.
s0540.idiomatic: On xinwei day Tiemie was made minister of war with a tiger tally; Mingsi Xedashi was made vice minister of war with a gold tally, and they were sent as envoys to Luobo'er.

s0541.literal: Censorate officials said: "Auditing revenues and grain from the beginning of the Zhongtong era until now spans more than thirty years; under Ahmad and Sangge the methods reached their limit, and their remaining partisans openly take bribes — the people cannot bear it; it would be better to abolish it.
s0541.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Auditing revenues and grain from the beginning of the Zhongtong era until now spans more than 30 years; under Ahmad and Sangge the methods reached their limit, and their remaining partisans openly take bribes — the people cannot bear it; it would be better to abolish it.

s0543.literal: " On renshen day the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat was established, administered from Bianliang.
s0543.idiomatic: On renshen day the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat was established, administered from Bianliang.

s0544.literal: Sariman and Laoshou were both made grand steward and placed in charge of the Office of Imperial Sacrifices.
s0544.idiomatic: Sariman and Laoshou were both made grand steward and placed in charge of the Office of Imperial Sacrifices.

s0545.literal: Central Secretariat officials said: "Jiangnan under the Song had more than seventy categories of corvee and levy; after submission none were collected; now apportioned to princely fiefs and cities, annual grants depend on the capital, and salaries of inner and outer officials are low — it seems appropriate to add somewhat; Jiangnan may be ordered to pay all levies according to Song categories in full.
s0545.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Jiangnan under the Song had more than 70 categories of corvee and levy; after submission none were collected; now apportioned to princely fiefs and cities, annual grants depend on the capital, and salaries of inner and outer officials are low — it seems appropriate to add somewhat; Jiangnan may be ordered to pay all levies according to Song categories in full.

s0546.literal: " He Rongzu said: "Officials in each province charged with revenues and grain should be summoned to the capital to assemble and deliberate on methods of collection and memorialize."
s0546.idiomatic: He Rongzu said, "Officials in each province charged with revenues and grain should be summoned to the capital to assemble and deliberate on methods of collection and memorialize."

s0548.literal: On jiaxu day an edict: "Auditing revenues and grain is abolished; documents on overdue revenues and grain from former years shall be gathered and placed in one room; viewing them without imperial command is a crime.
s0548.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict ordered, "Auditing revenues and grain is abolished; documents on overdue revenues and grain from former years shall be gathered and placed in one room; viewing them without imperial command is a crime.

s0549.literal: " Envoys were still dispatched to proclaim this throughout inner and outer realms.
s0549.idiomatic: Envoys were still dispatched to proclaim this throughout inner and outer realms.

s0550.literal: On gengchen day the moon transgressed the Imperial Woman.
s0550.idiomatic: On gengchen day the moon transgressed the Imperial Woman.

s0551.literal: Prefectures and commanderies north of the Jiang were severed and placed under the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat; the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat was changed to the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, administered from Hangzhou.
s0551.idiomatic: Prefectures and commanderies north of the Jiang were severed and placed under the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat; the Jiang-Huai Branch Secretariat was changed to the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, administered from Hangzhou.

s0552.literal: Rice was issued to relieve famine among Kuokuochu's people.
s0552.idiomatic: Rice was issued to relieve famine among Kuokuochu's people.

s0553.literal: Jarudai said: "Nayan's remnant partisans have fled into Jurchen lands; I and Yuerlu have deliberated; we request an additional fifteen hundred troops to pacify them."
s0553.idiomatic: Jarudai said, "Nayan's remnant partisans have fled into Jurchen lands; I and Yuerlu have deliberated; we request an additional 1,500 troops to pacify them."

s0555.literal: On guiwei day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.
s0555.idiomatic: On guiwei day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart Senior Minister.

s0556.literal: Flooding at the Guangji Agency's Dachang and other garrison farms; nineteen thousand five hundred shi of field rent was remitted.
s0556.idiomatic: Flooding at the Guangji Agency's Dachang and other garrison farms; 19,500 shi of field rent was remitted.

s0557.literal: Pingluan Route and the Fengshan and Jimin agencies suffered famine; fifteen thousand shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0557.idiomatic: Pingluan Route and the Fengshan and Jimin agencies suffered famine; 15,000 shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0558.literal: Baidu'erding had previously refused office because of Sangge's despotism; he was ordered to resume as left vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
s0558.idiomatic: Baidu'erding had previously refused office because of Sangge's despotism; he was ordered to resume as left vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0559.literal: On bingxu day Eight Fan cave official Wu Jinshu and others submitted with more than twenty thousand people in two hundred fifty stockades under their command, came to court, and presented local products.
s0559.idiomatic: On bingxu day Eight Fan cave official Wu Jinshu and others submitted with more than 20,000 people in 250 stockades under their command, came to court, and presented local products.

s0560.literal: On wuzi day an edict released prisoners throughout the realm who were not convicted of homicide.
s0560.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict released prisoners throughout the realm who were not convicted of homicide.

s0561.literal: On jichou day Mars transgressed Fang.
s0561.idiomatic: On jichou day Mars transgressed Fang.

s0562.literal: On gengyin day Mars transgressed Gouquan.
s0562.idiomatic: On gengyin day Mars transgressed Gouquan.

s0563.literal: The Garrison Farm Intendant Commission was promoted to the Guiyun Intendant Office at rank 4a.
s0563.idiomatic: The garrison farm intendant commission was promoted to the Guiyun Intendant Office at rank 4a.

s0564.literal: On xinmao day the grain-transport dam river was dredged and dikes built.
s0564.idiomatic: On xinmao day the grain-transport dam river was dredged and dikes built.

s0565.literal: Chihlas bakshi was appointed Imperial Preceptor, placed in charge of Buddhist clergy and nuns of all countries.
s0565.idiomatic: Chihlas bakshi was appointed imperial preceptor, placed in charge of Buddhist clergy and nuns of all countries.

s0566.literal: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were granted gold, silver, notes, and silks as in the annual precedent.
s0566.idiomatic: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were granted gold, silver, notes, and silks as in the annual precedent.

s0567.literal: Monks Luozang and others were ordered to conduct Buddhist rites in seated meditation in rotation at Shengshou Wan'an, Zhuozhou Temple, and other sites — fifty sessions in all.
s0567.idiomatic: Monks Luozang and others were ordered to conduct Buddhist rites in seated meditation in rotation at Shengshou Wan'an, Zhuozhou Temple, and other sites — 50 sessions in all.

s0568.literal: Daoist master Zhang Zhixian was dispatched bearing incense to pray at the Eastern Sea peak and stream, and the Ji River.
s0568.idiomatic: Daoist master Zhang Zhixian was dispatched bearing incense to pray at the Eastern Sea peak and stream, and the Ji River.

s0569.literal: The Ministry of Revenue reported household counts for the realm: inner commanderies one million nine hundred ninety-nine thousand four hundred forty-four; Jiang-Huai and Sichuan eleven million four hundred thirty thousand eight hundred seventy-eight; population fifty-nine million eight hundred forty-eight thousand nine hundred sixty-four; itinerant dependents four hundred twenty-nine thousand one hundred eighteen.
s0569.idiomatic: The ministry of revenue reported household counts for the realm: inner commanderies 1,999,444; Jiang-Huai and Sichuan 11,430,878; population 59,848,964; itinerant dependents 429,118.

s0570.literal: The Ministry of Agriculture reported schools established on all routes numbered slightly more than twenty-one thousand three hundred; reclaimed land slightly more than one thousand nine hundred eighty-three qing; mulberry, jujube, and other trees planted twenty-two million five hundred twenty-seven thousand seven hundred-plus; charity grain ninety-nine thousand nine hundred sixty shi.
s0570.idiomatic: The ministry of agriculture reported schools established on all routes numbered slightly more than 21,300; reclaimed land slightly more than 1,983 qing; mulberry, jujube, and other trees planted 22,527,700-plus; charity grain 99,960 shi.

s0571.literal: The Xuanzheng Court reported temples throughout the realm numbered forty-two thousand three hundred eighteen; monks and nuns two hundred thirteen thousand one hundred forty-eight persons.
s0571.idiomatic: The Xuanzheng Court reported temples throughout the realm numbered 42,318; monks and nuns 213,148 persons.

s0572.literal: Fifty-five persons were sentenced to death.
